context.title: Mark XRs not ready while waiting, and replicas until each object is
context.body:
### Description of your changes

Broken by #101, which marked a ModelReplica's non-workload Objects ready as soon as it observed them. #142 then gave the endpoint picker a readiness query that marking ignored.

compose-model-replica marked every composed Object other than its workloads ready once observed. That included one that failed to create, such as a picker Service the API server rejected for an invalid name, and the picker's Deployment before it was Available, though Envoy AI Gateway fails closed without a picker whatever the pool's `failureMode` says. Either way the replica reported Ready and compose-model-deployment put it into rotation. It now relays each Object's own Ready condition, as its readiness policy decides. Under `SuccessfulCreate` that catches an Object that never applied, but not a later update the API server rejects.

Separately, Crossplane counts an XR Ready when every composed resource is ready, so an XR with nothing composed is Ready. A ModelReplica waiting for its InferenceCluster, a ModelCache with no cluster to stage onto or waiting for its auth token, a ModelDeployment with no InferenceClusters, an InferenceCluster waiting for its InferenceClasses and a GKECluster waiting for its ProviderConfig all reported `Ready=True` beside a condition or event saying they were waiting. Each now marks itself not ready where it reports the wait.

On EKS, before the change, a ModelDeployment and a ModelCache that matched no cluster were `Ready=True`, and a replica whose picker Service had failed to create was Ready with a ModelEndpoint. After it, the first two were `Ready=False`, and with the picker's Deployment made unavailable the replica went `Ready=False` with `Unready resources: epp` and its ModelEndpoint was withdrawn, then both came back once the picker did.

I have: <!-- You MUST either [x] check or [ ] ~strike through~ every item. -->

- [x] Read and followed Modelplane's [contribution process](https://github.com/modelplaneai/modelplane/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Run `nix flake check` (or `./nix.sh flake check`) and made sure it passes.
- [x] Added or updated tests covering any composition function changes.
- [x] Signed off every commit with `git commit -s`.

commits.messageHeadline: Mark a ModelReplica's objects ready only once each reports Ready
commits.messageBody:
compose-model-replica marked every composed Object other than its workloads
ready as soon as it was observed. That included one that had failed to
create, such as a picker Service rejected for an invalid name, and the
endpoint picker's Deployment before it was Available, though its Object has
a CEL readiness query for exactly that and Envoy AI Gateway fails closed
without a picker. Either way the replica reported Ready and
compose-model-deployment put it into rotation.

This relays each Object's own Ready condition instead, as its readiness
policy decides.

Signed-off-by: Nic Cope <nicc@rk0n.org>

commits.messageHeadline: Report XRs not ready while they wait with nothing composed
commits.messageBody:
Crossplane counts an XR ready when every resource composed for it is ready,
so one with nothing composed, or only resources marked ready, reports Ready.
A ModelReplica waiting for its InferenceCluster, a ModelCache with no
cluster to stage onto or waiting for its auth token, a ModelDeployment with
no InferenceClusters, an InferenceCluster waiting for its InferenceClasses
and a GKECluster waiting for its ProviderConfig all reported Ready while
saying they were waiting.

Signed-off-by: Nic Cope <nicc@rk0n.org>
